description:
Answer "does this WordPress block theme convert to Drupal with WordPal". The WordPal gallery converts every block theme on wordpress.org each night. With slug: one theme and its routes. Without slug: counts by status and the most installed themes.
- version: the theme version wordpress.org lists now. run: the run the gallery shows. run.theme_version is the version it converted, which can be older.
- run.status (exact, diff, failed) is a verdict on the home page only. exact: its markup has no difference and its screenshot matches the WordPress screenshot. diff: the markup differs, the screenshots differ, or the two pages could not be compared. failed: no pair of home page screenshots, as when the conversion fails.
- Filters combine: status (run.status), tag, q. count: themes that pass all three. by_status: themes that pass tag and q, per status.
- Row: slug, name, installs, version, and run with status, routes_measured, routes_matching, markup_diffs_total. Up to eight pages are compared per theme. markup_diffs_total sums their markup differences.
- theme: the row, plus author, tags and page_url. Its run adds plugins to install first, convert_command, reason when failed, wordpal_release and image links.
- run.routes: route, markup_outcome (match, diff, skipped, error) and markup_diffs. A markup difference is an element, a class, an attribute or an inline style that differs.
- A route whose screenshots were compared also has visual_outcome (match, diff, unstable, error), visual_bands, visual_changed, wp_height and drupal_height.
- wp_only_rows and drupal_only_rows: pixel rows that one screenshot alone has. visual_bands and visual_changed count the rows both screenshots have.
- history: every run the gallery has shown for the theme, newest first, home page only. direction (improved, regressed, same, changed) compares a run with the run before.
- next_offset is absent on the last page.

offset.description: Skip this many themes in the same ranked order. Pass the previous page's next_offset.

q.description: Filter: part of a slug or of a theme name, in any case.

slug.description: A wordpress.org theme slug, for example twentytwentyfive. Returns that theme and its routes. The filters do not apply.

tag.description: Filter: a wordpress.org tag slug, for example blog.

name: wordpal_theme
title: WordPress theme conversion status
